description: Read the latest AI Overview check for the site's tracked queries: whether an AI Overview appeared and whether it cited the user's domain. Paid plans also get up to 90 days of sampled presence for up to 10 queries. Use this when the user asks whether they appear in Google AI Overviews or whether AI answers cite them. An empty trend means not sampled, not absent. Read-only. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_aio_visibility
title: AI Overview presence and citations
